title: Isolated Fetal Splenic Cyst : Prenatal Diagnosis and Postnatal Evolution
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to describe prevalence, radiologic and ultrasound evolution during pregnancy, postnatal evolution and treatment strategy in case of isolated fetal spelnic cyst
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnent women with an isolated suspected fetal splenic cyst between 2007 and 2017 in Montpellier Prenatal Diagnosis Center

Exclusion Criteria:

* All others fetal diagnosis
study_population: Pregnent women with an isolated suspected fetal splenic cyst
